subject: Outreach renewal: license consolidation, fallback options, and PO timeline
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Outreach renewal: license consolidation + fallback planning

Team —

Outreach renewal window opens in early April for our enterprise contract (renewal start 2028-05-01). I want to avoid a last-minute scramble; goal is to: 1) confirm true seat utilization, 2) decide whether to consolidate seats across teams, and 3) outline a fallback plan if vendor concessions don’t meet budget.

Quick asks: can Neha pull a seat-by-seat usage export (last 12 months) and attach an allocation by team? Marcus — please think through the commercial levers we should push (multi-year, committed seats, add-ons we can drop). Marissa — what does CS need to keep in place to avoid churn during any transition?

I’d like a short internal decision by Friday 3/23 so we can start negotiations the following week. I’ll loop in legal if we have hard pushbacks.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jared Klein <jared.klein@outreach.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outreach renewal: license consolidation + fallback planning

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the heads up. Attached is our current renewal summary and a PO draft (Outreach_PO_Draft_v2.pdf). For transparency, the baseline renewal quote assumes current seat counts with a standard 7% platform increase. We can offer a temporary blended discount for multi-year commitments.

I've also included a CSV export with last 12 months of API and seat activity (license-usage-report.csv) — should help Neha map active users vs dormant seats. If you want a staged path to reduce costs, we can model a 12- or 18-month ramp with an early-termination credit for seats removed after month 6.

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute modeling call next Tue to run scenarios.

—Jared
Jared Klein
Renewals Manager, Outreach
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 Mar 2028 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outreach renewal: usage export + preliminary allocation

Evelyn / Marcus —

Attached is the cleaned usage export I requested from Outreach (license-usage-report.csv). High level: ~18% of seats show zero activity in the last 6 months (across biz-dev and partner teams). Another ~12% are low-frequency (1–3 sessions/month). Total committed seats: 1,240; active seats (>=10 sessions/month): ~890.

Notes: some seats are reserved for pilots with Acme Corp (they're included now but will ramp down in Q3). I red-flagged 120 seats on the partner team that can be reclaimed with minimal impact — we should confirm with Marissa before we reassign.

Next step: Marcus, can you craft a target commitment (floor) and an ask to Outreach for a staged reduction? I can produce a delta model (costs vs. seat reduction scenarios) by Monday.

- Neha
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outreach renewal: license consolidation + fallback planning — legal redlines

Team —

Quick legal take after reviewing Outreach_PO_Draft_v2.pdf and the standard MSA:
- We should push for explicit data export and retention rights (customer-owned exports on termination).
- Limit auto-renewal to a 30-day opt-out window with notice obligations to avoid surprise renewals.
- Request SLA credits (service availability) be explicit in the renewal rather than in a separate schedule.
- Remove or cap the indemnity carve-outs that could expose us for partners’ misuse.

I'll prepare a redline (Renewal_Redlines_20280319.docx) with suggested language. For negotiation, recommend we ask for: 10% discount on list for 18 months OR a 6% discount for a 36-month committed term plus 1 free implementation service credit.

Sooj
Soojín Lee
Senior Counsel
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outreach renewal: negotiation approach + fallback runway

Team —

Read Neha's numbers and Soojin's redlines. Proposed negotiation play:
1) Primary ask: 18-month renewal at 10% off current list with explicit data export and SLA credits (as legal asked).
2) If vendor pushes back, offer a 24–36 month split (2+1) with a 6% headline discount + 1 implementation credit.
3) Concurrent fallback: provision up to 50 Salesloft seats (trial) for SDRs who can be transitioned within 60 days if Outreach terms don’t meet economic targets. We keep core enterprise seats intact to avoid churn.

Budget note: finance has approved short-term funds for pilot costs, but long-term commit needs CFO sign-off. We should present recommended path and ask for accelerated approval if Outreach can't meet the 10% ask.

Marcus
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Klein <jared.klein@outreach.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outreach renewal: license consolidation, fallback options, and PO timeline

Jared —

Thanks for the export and PO draft. Internal consensus: we want to pursue the 18-month path with a target commercial ask of 10% off list + the legal redlines (data export, SLA credits, limited auto-renew). Please send an updated PO and DocuSign envelope with the redline changes accepted or clearly marked where Outreach cannot accommodate.

If Outreach cannot provide the 10% for 18 months, we are prepared to propose the alternative (36-month blended at 6% + implementation credit) OR to move up a pilot with Salesloft for up to 50 SDR seats (60-day transition runway). We’d like to start the formal negotiation this week so procurement can route the PO through finance. Can you confirm Outreach’s timeline to return an updated DocuSign by next Tue 3/28?

Attachments: Outreach_PO_Draft_v2.pdf, license-usage-report.csv, Renewal_Redlines_20280319.docx

Regards,
Evelyn
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
